text: Great location, super friendly staff. Room was spotless and the rooftop view is incredible. Will definitely come back!

Perfect weekend getaway. Rooftop bar is amazing, staff were attentive and helpful. Room smelled fresh and clean.
Average stay. The check-in wait was long and the elevator was slow. Room was decent but nothing special. Overpriced for what you get.
Fantastic hotel. Location in Williamsburg is perfect. Breakfast options are great. Highly recommend to anyone visiting Brooklyn.
